step1.description:
When it comes to UIs I've long held the perspective reactivity is all you need. Defeating synchronization gremlins is over half the battle. To accomplish that we'e built incredible synchronous systems. Async while recognized as important has been largely an add-on; an afterthought. Today I'm going to look at what Signals reactivity would look if we started with async in mind.
